items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I always played the first trombone with Louie and I would take charge of the trombone section and different guys would come in andout

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

I see. Okay. Let's see you made some recordings later in the year with the Louie Armstrong orchestra and noting from the discography there was a change in personnel, especially in the trumpet section and in the trombone section. There's always changes in personnel but it seems that the trumpet and trombone people this time were the ones that were replaced or left the orchestra for one reason or another, while the reed section stayed intact. Joe Garland was in that. Don Hill, John Sparrow and Amos Gordon Ernest…

Well, at different times when a man would come in from a tour back in New York, invariably some of the brass men, I don't know how it turned out that way -- would leave. Maybe they couldn't stand the road or anything like that. I always played the first trombone with Louie and I would take charge of the trombone section and different guys would come in andout, I guess they were tired of the road --
